title: Bangladesh Fish Production Statistics, 1983-84 to 2024-25: Summary Tables and Harmonized Data

creators.name: Rabbi, Md Siful Islam
creators.affiliation: Noakhali Science and Technology University, Noakhali-3814, Bangladesh

description:
National, waterbody-wise, species-wise and district-wise fish production statistics of Bangladesh, compiled from 23 Department of Fisheries yearbooks of fisheries statistics (2002-03 to 2024-25), with the national series back to 1983-84.

Volume 1: Summary Tables (PDF, Word, Excel): yearly total, inland capture, inland culture and marine production (1983-84 to 2024-25); production by waterbody; water area and yield; production by species group (2002-03 to 2024-25); inland production by district for all 64 districts.

Volume 2: Detailed Data Files (CSV, Excel): long-format tables with the source yearbook and table for every figure, both the latest revised and the originally published values, district-by-waterbody and species-by-waterbody tables, beel and Kaptai Lake species detail, name crosswalks, and 56 documented data notes. Every table was checked against the totals printed in the yearbooks.

Not an official publication of the Department of Fisheries, Bangladesh. Unit: metric tonnes. Years are Bangladesh fiscal years (July-June).
